review:
High society on paylines, built around Golden Frames. Frames land during a spin and reveal a multiplier or a jackpot once the grid settles – and count when their symbol is part of a winning line.

Multiplier Frames run from 2x to 100x and add together; Jackpot Frames award one of four jackpots, starting with the 25x Mini, either in a win or when collected by a Clover Crystal. Frames clear each spin. 20,000x max; Hacksaw doesn't publish RTP or volatility outside the game.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw Gaming doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
Hacksaw Gaming doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
